head_coach.name: Graham Arnold
head_coach.play_style_summary: Combines pragmatic defensive organization with an aggressive attacking mentality. Focuses on maintaining high pressing, dominating ball possession, and utilizing wide overloads from full-backs to support a high-risk, high-reward front four.

key_players.name: Marko Farji
key_players.performance_stats: Plays for Venezia FC [1.1.4]. Known for his pace and technical ability to cut inside from the left wing to create attacking chances in transitions.

key_players.name: Ali Al-Hamadi
key_players.performance_stats: Plays for Luton Town. Serving as a key physical striker leading the front line with high work rate and pressing capabilities.

key_players.name: Aimar Sher
key_players.performance_stats: Plays for Sarpsborg 08 FF. Acting as a controlling presence in the midfield pivot, breaking lines with his distribution and defensive positioning.
